mandate: ZEFB implications; zero-entangled frequency theory; key gate closures summary

ZEFB.definition: When a frequency parameter in a multiplicative sum is constrained to be the imaginary part of a zero of zeta (or an L-function), generic Diophantine, metric, and free-frequency large-value theorems do not transfer to that frequency.

applies_to: Form C at rho* = beta* + i gamma*
sum Lambda(n) n^{-rho*} and prime subsums at s=rho*
any n-aspect phase alignment targeting a zero ordinate
smoothed Weil forms S_g(rho*) at the same frozen frequency
does_not_apply_to: free-t large values of zeta(1/2+it) (different barrier: not ZEFB; those work)
generic gamma not tied to zeros
Re s > 1 absolute Euler products (no zero entanglement)
on-line SOC with free path parameter t (until t is forced to a zero height)

mechanisms.name: Euler / log-derivative singularity
mechanisms.detail: log zeta(s) and zeta'/zeta(s) have singularities at zeros; partial Euler sums sum_{p<=Y} p^{-s} are not independent of the vanishing of zeta at rho*

mechanisms.name: Non-generic ordinate
mechanisms.detail: Metric theorems for almost-all real gamma miss the measure-zero set of zero ordinates; zero ordinates are arithmetic-special

mechanisms.name: Circularity risk
mechanisms.detail: Using zeta(rho*)=0 to force prime-sum cancellation or alignment can assume what Form C is trying to extract; non-circular EF feedback remains open

mechanisms.name: Parameter independence failure
mechanisms.detail: In free Diophantine problems, frequency and coefficients can be chosen independently; here frequency is defined by the zero of the same L-function generating the coefficients

implications.Form_C: Standard n-aspect Diophantine does not prove Form C; need zero-aware methods or other B_theta gates
implications.FFML_complement: FFML blocks free-t; ZEFB blocks generic frozen-t treated as free Diophantine
escape_routes: Non-circular EF feedback using zero condition carefully (open)
Conditional Form C under named hypotheses
implications.kappa_SOC: ZEFB is primarily a Form C / fixed-rho* barrier; kappa dual is zeta'/zeta (MA8), different entanglement
implications.programme_strategy: If pursuing B_theta, either invent zero-aware Form C technology or route through Iso_H/DH; do not spend effort on almost-all gamma Diophantine

theory_sketch.name: Zero-entangled frequency theory (programme-level)
objects: Free frequency: t in continuous large-value problems
Generic frequency: almost-all real t in metric number theory
principles: P-ZEF-1: Free-frequency theorems do not automatically specialize to entangled frequencies (FFML)
P-ZEF-2: Generic/metric frequency theorems do not automatically specialize to entangled frequencies (ZEFB)
P-ZEF-3: Identities that are singular at zeros require principal-value / excluded-neighborhood interpretation when s->rho*
P-ZEF-4: Dual descriptions (primes vs zeros) at an entangled frequency are two sides of the same singularity, not independent inputs
examples_entangled: argument of zeta approaching rho* along a path
examples_free: Im D_X(t) maximized over t for fixed X
theory_sketch.standing: programme taxonomy — not a published classical theory name; ZLA-clean

gate_closures.note: Closure = proved/accepted programme standing, not RH

closed_identities_and_partials.gate: R4.1 GHK strip (off-line error control shape)
Monodromy of P_X as phase engine
On-line strong model Im D_X at fixed X

global_conclusion: ZEFB implications formalized: blocks generic Diophantine transfer to zero ordinates; complements FFML; does not kill Form C truth-value. Zero-entangled frequency theory recorded as four principles (free/generic/entangled taxonomy). Key closures are identities, implications-under-hyp, partial Omega, duals, and dead-route locks — not RH/O-TL/Form C.
